mapper.select: SELECT id, snapshot_id, task_id, attempt_id, round_no, stage, snapshot_path, cleanup_status, expire_time, deleted_time, create_time, update_time FROM ai_xhs_publish_snapshot WHERE snapshot_id = #{snapshotId}

SELECT id, snapshot_id, task_id, attempt_id, round_no, stage, snapshot_path, cleanup_status, expire_time, deleted_time, create_time, update_time FROM ai_xhs_publish_snapshot WHERE task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY round_no DESC, id DESC

SELECT id, snapshot_id, task_id, attempt_id, round_no, stage, snapshot_path, cleanup_status, expire_time, deleted_time, create_time, update_time FROM ai_xhs_publish_snapshot WHERE expire_time IS NOT NULL AND expire_time <= #{expireTime} ORDER BY expire_time ASC, id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_xhs_publish_snapshot ( snapshot_id, task_id, attempt_id, round_no, stage, snapshot_path, cleanup_status, expire_time, deleted_time) VALUES ( #{snapshotId}, #{taskId}, #{attemptId}, #{roundNo}, #{stage}, #{snapshotPath}, #{cleanupStatus}, #{expireTime}, #{deletedTime})
